ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What is Local SEO and how is it different from regular SEO?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Regular SEO targets broad national or industry-wide keywords. Local SEO targets suburb and city-specific searches — things like “plumber in Centurion” or “electrician Sandton.” We build dedicated pages for each area you serve so Google understands exactly where your business operates and shows you to customers nearby.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How many location pages do I need to rank across multiple suburbs?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: One page per target area is the baseline. If you serve 10 suburbs, you need 10 unique location pages — one for each. Copying the same content across pages does not work and can hurt your rankings. Every page we build has unique copy, its own keyword focus and its own schema markup.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How long before my location pages start ranking?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Most location pages start showing movement within 2 to 3 months. Top-3 positions for competitive suburbs typically take 4 to 6 months. The more locations you target, the more compound the effect — pages reinforce each other through internal linking and shared authority.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do my location pages need to be completely unique or can they be similar?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: They must be genuinely unique — different headings, different copy, different local references. Google penalises thin or duplicate location pages. Every page we build is written from scratch with real local context: nearby landmarks, area-specific services and suburb-level keyword targeting.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can Local SEO work if I don’t have a physical address in every suburb I target?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes. You do not need an office in every suburb to rank there. You need a location page that clearly signals you serve that area, the right local keywords, proper schema markup and enough authority signals pointing to that page. Many of our clients serve entire provinces from one location.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What happens to my location pages if I cancel?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: You keep everything. The pages, the content, the rankings they have earned — all of it stays on your site. There are no lock-in contracts. Rankings may soften over time without ongoing optimisation as competitors keep pushing, but the foundation we build is yours permanently.
